messages:
ana (CSM): Heads-up — VerdantAI is spinning up a promo in AP-South and asked for a temporary throughput bump + header-based allowlist for their payment gateway partner. Can we handle a short-lived QPS increase and header whitelist?
mike (SRE): What numbers are they asking for? and which header exactly?
ana (CSM): They want 3x current QPS for 48h starting tomorrow 09:00 IST. Header: `X-PSP-Signature` from `payments.verdant.ai` domain. They said it's only traffic from their partner IPs but PSU requires header check too.
alina (Support): Account health: VerdantAI is on Standard plan, no active incidents, but renewal touch point in ~6 weeks. This promo is a customer ask; success here could affect renewal. Recommend we make it low-friction.
raj (AE): If we do a temporary bump, we should sync billing — likely they'll want a one-off commit or a promo credit. I'll prep a PO-ok email. No SLA change.
mike (SRE): Technically fine. We can add a per-customer policy routing rule + header allowlist on the ingress LB. Suggest: 3x QPS capped at 500 RPS burst, auto-revoke after 48h. Need infra approval for infra change window.
infra-bot: @mike created change request CR-2026 to add header allowlist rule for customer:verdantai.ETA: 2h review.
ana (CSM): Thanks. Also request: can we scope it to ap-south region only and fallback to rate-limited model in other regions? They don't want cross-region failover for this promo.
mike (SRE): Yes — will scope policy by region tag `ap-south-1`. Routing policy will be: if region==ap-south-1 and header==X-PSP-Signature@payments.verdant.ai then allow higher QPS, else regular quota.
alina (Support): Can we have a short checklist for customer-facing comms? I can send step-by-step to their ops: expected window, when header needs to be present, and contact for rollback.
ana (CSM): Please include the example curl we gave them earlier. sample:
```
curl -H "X-PSP-Signature: <sig>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
mike (SRE): For internal ops: config patch will look like:
```
- customer: verdantai
  region: ap-south-1
  header_allowlist:
    name: X-PSP-Signature
    match: payments.verdant.ai
  qps_override: 500
  expires_at: 2026-04-15T03:00:00Z
```
raj (AE): I set expectation w/ customer: we will bill standard overage unless we agree a credit. They replied "please waive small overages for this promo" — I'll get final sign-off.
ana (CSM): Good. Mike — can infra-bot tag this as "auto-revoke" and post a reminder 2 hours before expiry?
infra-bot: Tagging CR-2026 with `auto-revoke` and scheduled reminder at 2026-04-14T23:00:00Z.
mike (SRE): Deployment plan: apply policy in staging tonight for a smoke test, apply to production 30m before start time. I'll post rollback steps here.
mike (SRE): Rollback: remove header rule and reset qps_override to customer default; flush any sticky routing caches. Will do canary in 3 nodes then full roll.
alina (Support): I'll draft the customer note and include monitoring dashboard links + who to ping if they see 429s.
ana (CSM): Awesome — thanks team. tagging @raj once PO is in, we'll schedule the bump. :rocket:
